{{Top|leg}}
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], the [[Five Worlds]] government of the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] assembled a '''decoy fleet''' of decommissioned and nearly derelict [[Starship/Legends|vessels]], and brought it to a deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] rendezvous point to conduct negotiations with the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Hoclaw]]'s [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Valorum (Victory-class)|''Valorum'']] served as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the fleet. The negotiations were a farce, however, as [[Five World Prime Minister]] [[Sadras Koyan]] was simply attempting to lure Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] to the negotiation site in order to fire [[Centerpoint Station]], an ancient [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] that hung in the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Star system/Legends|system]], at Solo's [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]]. A [[Battle of the rendezvous point|battle]] occurred between the decoy [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] and the [[Second Fleet (Galactic Alliance)|Galactic Alliance Second Fleet]], and Corellian reinforcements arrived to help. Centerpoint's [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] weapon fired and destroyed the GA Second Fleet and the decoy fleet.
